title: China Map of Ancient Cities
synopsis: Set foot in the famous ancient cities of Beijing, Nanjing, and Xi’an and experience the unique charm of these former imperial capitals. Get ready for a fascinating journey through China’s history.

fullText.simplified:
中国古城地图

    中国是一个历史很长的国家，如果想了解历史上的中国，一定要去中国的古城看看。北京、南京和西安是不能错过的三座古城。
    说到北京，就要先了解一下北京的历史了。近八百年前，皇帝们开始住在北京。所以，现在在北京还可以看到皇帝的房子——故宫，也能看到皇帝的花园——颐和园。现在的北京有六环，二环里面就是以前的老北京。这里除了皇帝的房子，还有很多普通人的房子。如果在地图上看北京，二环里的北京很有意思：东边和西边长得一样。如果你先去东边，就能知道西边该怎么走了。
    南京也很有名，以前也有不少皇帝住在这儿。南京在中国南方的江苏，从两千六百年前开始，南京就是一座城市了。一千八百年前，第一次有皇帝住在南京。从那以后，南京越来越大，到了一千年以前，南京已经变成了中国最有钱的城市之一了。南京玄武湖就是这些皇帝们的花园，这儿还有北京故宫的“妈妈”——南京故宫。除了这些，南京还有很多山和湖，都有历史故事。南京还有一件有意思的事情：南京人非常爱吃鸭子，人们常说，没有一只鸭子能离开南京。
    西安是这几个古城里最老的一座，从三千年前开始，皇帝们就开始住在西安。因为西安在陕西，在中国的中心。所以，秦朝、汉朝和唐朝的皇帝都住在西安。虽然那时候皇帝的房子已经不在了，但是兵马俑还在。在这座城市，坐地铁可能会有些困难。因为这里每个地方都有历史名人的东西，修建地铁时，要先把这些东西搬走，所以西安的地铁修得非常慢。
    在这几个古城，都可以看到中国的历史。如果你想了解中国历史，那么这几个古城是你一定要去的宝地。
fullText.traditional:
中國古城地圖

    中國是一個歷史很長的國家，如果想了解歷史上的中國，一定要去中國的古城看看。北京、南京和西安是不能錯過的三座古城。
    說到北京，就要先了解一下北京的歷史了。近八百年前，皇帝們開始住在北京。所以，現在在北京還可以看到皇帝的房子——故宮，也能看到皇帝的花園——頤和園。現在的北京有六環，二環裡面就是以前的老北京。這裡除了皇帝的房子，還有很多普通人的房子。如果在地圖上看北京，二環裡的北京很有意思：東邊和西邊長得一樣。如果你先去東邊，就能知道西邊該怎麼走了。
    南京也很有名，以前也有不少皇帝住在這兒。南京在中國南方的江蘇，從兩千六百年前開始，南京就是一座城市了。一千八百年前，第一次有皇帝住在南京。從那以後，南京越來越大，到了一千年以前，南京已經變成了中國最有錢的城市之一了。南京玄武湖就是這些皇帝們的花園，這兒還有北京故宮的“媽媽”——南京故宮。除了這些，南京還有很多山和湖，都有歷史故事。南京還有一件有意思的事情：南京人非常愛吃鴨子，人們常說，沒有一隻鴨子能離開南京。
    西安是這幾個古城裡最老的一座，從三千年前開始，皇帝們就開始住在西安。因為西安在陝西，在中國的中心。所以，秦朝、漢朝和唐朝的皇帝都住在西安。雖然那時候皇帝的房子已經不在了，但是兵馬俑還在。在這座城市，坐地鐵可能會有些困難。因為這裡每個地方都有歷史名人的東西，修建地鐵時，要先把這些東西搬走，所以西安的地鐵修得非常慢。
    在這幾個古城，都可以看到中國的歷史。如果你想了解中國歷史，那麼這幾個古城是你一定要去的寶地。

sentences.pinyin: yě néng kàn dào huáng dì de huā yuán yí hé yuán

If you go to the east side first, you’ll know where to go on the west side.

sentences.traditional: 南京也很有名，以前也有不少皇帝住在這兒。

sentences.traditional: 南京在中國南方的江蘇，從兩千六百年前開始，南京就是一座城市了。
sentences.pinyin: nán jīng zài zhōng guó nán fāng de jiāng sū cóng liǎng qiān liù bǎi nián qián kāi shǐ nán jīng jiù shì yí zuò chéng shì le

sentences.simplified: 一千八百年前，第一次有皇帝住在南京。
sentences.traditional: 一千八百年前，第一次有皇帝住在南京。
sentences.pinyin: yì qiān bā bǎi nián qián dì yī cì yǒu huáng dì zhù zài nán jīng
sentences.english: Nanjing is in the Jiangsu Province in southern China and has been a city since 2,600 years ago.

sentences.simplified: 从那以后，南京越来越大，到了一千年以前，南京已经变成了中国最有钱的城市之一了。
sentences.traditional: 從那以後，南京越來越大，到了一千年以前，南京已經變成了中國最有錢的城市之一了。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu nán jīng yuè lái yuè dà dào le yì qiān nián yǐ qián nán jīng yǐ jīng biàn chéng le zhōng guó zuì yǒu qián de chéng shì zhī yī le
sentences.english: The first time an emperor lived in Nanjing was 1,800 years ago.

sentences.simplified: 南京玄武湖就是这些皇帝们的花园，

sentences.pinyin: nán jīng xuán wǔ hú jiù shì zhè xiē huáng dì men de huā yuán
sentences.english: Since then, Nanjing has grown bigger and bigger, and by 1,000 years ago, it had become one of the richest cities in China.

sentences.simplified: 这儿还有北京故宫的“妈妈”——南京故宫。
sentences.traditional: 這兒還有北京故宮的“媽媽”——南京故宮。
sentences.pinyin: zhè‘r hái yǒu běi jīng gù gōng de mā ma nán jīng gù gōng
sentences.english: Nanjing Xuanwu Lake is the garden of these emperors.

sentences.simplified: 除了这些，南京还有很多山和湖，都有历史故事。
sentences.traditional: 除了這些，南京還有很多山和湖，都有歷史故事。
sentences.pinyin: chú le zhè xiē nán jīng hái yǒu hěn duō shān hé hú dōu yǒu lì shǐ gù shi
sentences.english: The “mother” of the Forbidden City in Beijing is also here—the Forbidden City of Nanjing.

sentences.simplified: 南京还有一件有意思的事情：
sentences.traditional: 南京還有一件有意思的事情：
sentences.pinyin: nán jīng hái yǒu yí jiàn yǒu yì si de shì qing
sentences.english: In addition to these, Nanjing has many mountains and lakes that have historical stories about them.

sentences.simplified: 南京人非常爱吃鸭子，人们常说，没有一只鸭子能离开南京。
sentences.traditional: 南京人非常愛吃鴨子，人們常說，沒有一隻鴨子能離開南京。
sentences.pinyin: nán jīng rén fēi cháng ài chī yā zi rén men cháng shuō méi yǒu yì zhī yā zi néng lí kāi nán jīng
sentences.english: Another interesting thing about Nanjing:
The people of Nanjing love to eat duck. People often say that no duck can leave Nanjing alive.

sentences.simplified: 西安是这几个古城里最老的一座，从三千年前开始，皇帝们就开始住在西安。
sentences.traditional: 西安是這幾個古城裡最老的一座，從三千年前開始，皇帝們就開始住在西安。
sentences.pinyin: xī ān shì zhè jǐ ge gǔ chéng lǐ zuì lǎo de yí zuò cóng sān qiān nián qián kāi shǐ huáng dì men jiù kāi shǐ zhù zài xī ān

sentences.simplified: 因为西安在陕西，在中国的中心。
sentences.traditional: 因為西安在陝西，在中國的中心。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi xī ān zài shǎn xī zài zhōng guó de zhōng xīn
sentences.english: Xi’an is the oldest of these ancient cities. Emperors started living in Xi’an 3,000 years ago.

sentences.simplified: 所以，秦朝、汉朝和唐朝的皇帝都住在西安。
sentences.traditional: 所以，秦朝、漢朝和唐朝的皇帝都住在西安。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ qín cháo hàn cháo hé táng cháo de huáng dì dōu zhù zài xī ān
sentences.english: Because Xi’an is in Shaanxi in the center of China.

sentences.simplified: 虽然那时候皇帝的房子已经不在了，但是兵马俑还在。
sentences.traditional: 雖然那時候皇帝的房子已經不在了，但是兵馬俑還在。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán nà shí hou huáng dì de fáng zi yǐ jīng bú zài le dàn shì bīng mǎ yǒng hái zài
sentences.english: Therefore, the emperors of the Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties all lived in Xi’an.

sentences.simplified: 在这座城市，坐地铁可能会有些困难。
sentences.traditional: 在這座城市，坐地鐵可能會有些困難。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè zuò chéng shì zuò dì tiě kě néng huì yǒu xiē kùn nan
sentences.english: Although the emperor’s house from that time is no longer there, the Terracotta Army is still there.

sentences.simplified: 因为这里每个地方都有历史名人的东西，
sentences.traditional: 因為這裡每個地方都有歷史名人的東西，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi zhè lǐ měi ge dì fang dōu yǒu lì shǐ míng rén de dōng xi
sentences.english: Taking the subway can be a bit difficult in this city.

sentences.simplified: 修建地铁时，要先把这些东西搬走，
sentences.traditional: 修建地鐵時，要先把這些東西搬走，
sentences.pinyin: xiū jiàn dì tiě shí yào xiān bǎ zhè xiē dōng xi bān zǒu
sentences.english: That’s because there are objects belonging to famous people in history everywhere, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以西安的地铁修得非常慢。
sentences.traditional: 所以西安的地鐵修得非常慢。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ xī ān de dì tiě xiū de fēi cháng màn
sentences.english: .. so when the subway was built, these objects had to be moved first.
So the subway in Xi’an was built very slowly.

sentences.simplified: 在这几个古城，都可以看到中国的历史。
sentences.traditional: 在這幾個古城，都可以看到中國的歷史。
sentences.pinyin: zài zhè jǐ ge gǔ chéng dōu kě yǐ kàn dào zhōng guó de lì shǐ

sentences.simplified: 如果你想了解中国历史，那么这几个古城是你一定要去的宝地。
sentences.traditional: 如果你想了解中國歷史，那麼這幾個古城是你一定要去的寶地。
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng liǎo jiě zhōng guó lì shǐ nà me zhè jǐ ge gǔ chéng shì nǐ yí dìng yào qù de bǎo dì
sentences.english: The history of China can be seen in these ancient cities.

sentence_translations: China Map of Ancient Cities
China is a country with a long history. If you want to learn about the history of China, you must visit the ancient cities of China.
Beijing, Nanjing, and Xi’an are three ancient cities that should not be missed.
Speaking of Beijing, we should understand a little about the history of Beijing.
Emperors began living in Beijing nearly 800 years ago.
So, nowadays in Beijing, you can still see the emperor’s house—the Forbidden City ..
.. and see the emperor’s garden—the Summer Palace.
Nowadays, Beijing has six ring roads. Inside the second ring road is the old Beijing of the past.
Besides the emperor’s house, there are also many houses of ordinary people here.
If you look at Beijing on a map, the part of Beijing inside the second ring road is very interesting:
The east side looks the same as the west side.
If you go to the east side first, you’ll know where to go on the west side.
Nanjing is also famous, and many emperors used to live here.
Nanjing is in the Jiangsu Province in southern China and has been a city since 2,600 years ago.
The first time an emperor lived in Nanjing was 1,800 years ago.
Since then, Nanjing has grown bigger and bigger, and by 1,000 years ago, it had become one of the richest cities in China.
Nanjing Xuanwu Lake is the garden of these emperors.
The “mother” of the Forbidden City in Beijing is also here—the Forbidden City of Nanjing.
In addition to these, Nanjing has many mountains and lakes that have historical stories about them.
Another interesting thing about Nanjing:
The people of Nanjing love to eat duck. People often say that no duck can leave Nanjing alive.
Xi’an is the oldest of these ancient cities. Emperors started living in Xi’an 3,000 years ago.
Because Xi’an is in Shaanxi in the center of China.
Therefore, the emperors of the Qin, Han, and Tang dynasties all lived in Xi’an.
Although the emperor’s house from that time is no longer there, the Terracotta Army is still there.
Taking the subway can be a bit difficult in this city.
That’s because there are objects belonging to famous people in history everywhere, ..
.. so when the subway was built, these objects had to be moved first.
So the subway in Xi’an was built very slowly.
The history of China can be seen in these ancient cities.
If you want to learn about Chinese history, then these ancient cities are treasures that you must visit.
